title: LLM Application Primitives
summary: Turn model behavior into dependable software: API calls, prompts that are specifications, schema-valid outputs, and cost control.
outcomes: Call model APIs with proper roles, error handling, and streaming awareness
Write prompts as testable specifications, not incantations
Guarantee machine-consumable output with schemas and validation
Engineer context, caching, and model choice for cost and latency budgets

lessons.title: Calling model APIs like an engineer
